# DonorDock Pricing

DonorDock offers straightforward pricing for nonprofit organizations:

## Pricing Tiers

**Free Plan**
- Up to 500 contacts
- Core CRM features
- Basic donor management
- Email integration
- Limited support

**Growth Plan** - **$39/month**
- Up to 2,000 contacts
- All Free features plus:
- Custom fields
- Email sequences
- Enhanced reporting
- Priority support

**Professional Plan** - **$99/month**
- Up to 10,000 contacts
- All Growth features plus:
- Advanced automation
- Custom dashboards
- API access
- Dedicated support

**Enterprise Plan** - **Custom pricing**
- Unlimited contacts
- All Professional features plus:
- Custom integrations
- Advanced security
- Dedicated account manager
- Custom training

## Key Features Across Plans
- Donor management & tracking
- Online donation forms
- Fundraising campaigns
- Task management
- Reporting & analytics

## Notes
- Pricing may vary, so I recommend checking their official website (donordock.com) for the most current information
- They typically offer discounts for annual billing
- Free trial available
